definitions: A fictional character in the Yu-Gi-Oh! franchise, known as 'Exodia the Forbidden One'.
In the Yu-Gi-Oh! card game, a specific set of five monster cards that, when all are in a player's hand, result in an automatic victory.
examples: He assembled all five pieces of Exodia.
The strategy revolved around drawing Exodia quickly.
Exodia is a powerful win condition.
